rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the punctuation mark “!”.

example.english: Look at the exclamation mark at the end—the whole sentence immediately feels much more forceful.
example.traditional: 你睇吓句末嗰個感歎號，成句嘢即刻有氣勢好多。
